purpose: Immutable exploratory data snapshots. GSW/FRED official retrieval was blocked during setup; the UCI official ZIP subsequently worked and matched the locked CSV checksum. Raw files and processed data are not committed.

canonical_yield_design.deviation: The exploratory fallback uses manufacturing capacity utilization CUMFNS, not total-industry TCU. The two series are not treated as interchangeable. Canonical TCU data remain pending official access.
canonical_yield_design.information_set: For target month t, use macro observations dated t-2. Inflation is 100 * log(CPI[t-2] / CPI[t-14]). These are revised vintage data, not historical real-time releases.

sources.attribution: Gurkaynak, Sack and Wright, The U.S. Treasury yield curve: 1961 to the present; Federal Reserve Board research data.
sources.units: SVENYxx are annualized percentage points, continuously compounded zero-coupon yields; xx is maturity in years. Do not use SVENPYxx par yields.
sources.license_note: Public Federal Reserve research product; live official terms were inaccessible during setup. This third-party snapshot has not been checksum-matched to the official source. Raw data are excluded from Git.
sources.revision_note: Staff research product subject to revision and methodological change; the vintage is frozen by commit and checksum.

sources.attribution: McCracken and Ng, FRED-MD: A Monthly Database for Macroeconomic Research; Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. Snapshot mirrored by Davide Mascioli.
sources.units: FEDFUNDS and CUMFNS are percent; CPIAUCSL is the seasonally adjusted CPI index. The FRED-MD Transform row is metadata and must not be parsed as an observation.
sources.license_note: Underlying series retain source terms; a mirror's code license does not relicense data. Live official source terms were inaccessible. Raw data are excluded from Git.
sources.revision_note: September 2026 revised vintage, not real-time observations available at past forecast origins.

sources.attribution: Vito, S. (2008). Air Quality [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C59K5F
sources.units: CO reference concentration in mg/m^3; PT08 sensor responses are not pollutant concentrations; T in Celsius, RH in percent, AH as supplied. Timestamps are local naive; no timezone is inferred.
sources.license_note: The verified UCI page displays CC BY 4.0, while its legacy description also says research-only and excludes commercial use. Retain both source notices and Vito/UCI attribution. This repository uses the data for academic research; raw data are excluded from Git.
sources.validation_note: The CSV extracted from the official UCI ZIP matched this SHA-256 during setup. All 9357 timestamps and 13 measurement values also agree with a separately attributed, reformatted mirror. 114 trailing empty rows are omitted; -200 means missing. Official descriptive metadata says 9358 rows and an earlier end date, but the actual official file contains 9357 hourly rows through 2005-04-04.
